data.long_meaning: The name Ernie is derived from the Old English name 'Earnweald', which means 'strong ruler' or 'brave in battle'. This name was popular among the Anglo-Saxons and was often given to boys who were expected to display courage and loyalty. Ernie is a strong and enduring name that evokes images of bravery and resilience.
